scene_description: A compact stone brick room (9x9) with dark oak plank flooring, containing a single stone pressure plate near the back wall. The room is well-lit with lanterns and has an entrance opening in the front wall. The dark oak floor provides excellent visual contrast with the stone pressure plate, making it easy to locate. The player spawns with an iron pickaxe to mine the pressure plate efficiently.
task_text: Find and mine the stone pressure plate on the dark oak floor inside the stone brick room. Use the iron pickaxe in your hotbar to break it and collect it.
design_notes: The room uses a 9x9 stone brick enclosure with dark oak plank floor for maximum contrast with the stone pressure plate. The first /fill command clears a 13x7x13 area to remove any natural terrain/trees that might intrude. The entrance is a 3x3 opening in the north wall. The pressure plate is placed at ~0 ~0 ~3 (3 blocks south of spawn) flanked by two lanterns for visibility. A ceiling lantern provides ambient lighting. The player receives an iron pickaxe via /give for efficient mining.
